overview_description.description: FlexWash is a modern car wash POS system designed to streamline operations, grow membership revenue, and simplify daily management. Our all-in-one car wash software combines point-of-sale, CRM, marketing, and membership tools without the need for third-party add-ons. With real-time reporting, mobile handhelds, and LPR integration, FlexWash gives operators everything they need to run faster, smarter washes. Unlike legacy car wash point of sale systems, FlexWash is built for speed, ease of use, and flexibility across express, flex, and full-service formats. It adapts to your unique workflows and scales as your business grows. Car wash operators choose FlexWash to replace outdated software and unlock better insights, smoother transactions, and higher profitability.

product.name: FlexWash Car Wash POS + CRM
product.description: An integrated point-of-sale and customer relationship management system designed for car wash operations to track customers, sales, and memberships.

product.name: Advanced LPR (License Plate Recognition)
product.description: An AI-driven license plate recognition system that tracks and records vehicles entering the car wash for operational and marketing purposes.

product.name: Assisted Upselling Module
product.description: A tool that uses customer wash history to customize sales offers and pitches, helping car wash operators increase memberships and sales.

product.name: Marketing ROI Reporting
product.description: A reporting tool that tracks customer spending after coupon redemption to measure the return on investment of marketing channels.
